bm25._description: BM25F top-k, no fusion/rerank/iteration. Classic sparse retrieval baseline.

closed_book._description: No retrieval. Isolates how much the benchmark can be answered from the reader's parameters alone.

dense._description: Dense bi-encoder (bge-small-en-v1.5) top-k. Standard single-vector embedding baseline.

hybrid._description: Hybrid BM25F + dense with weighted RRF. Strong, widely deployed production baseline.

hybrid_rerank._description: Hybrid RRF + cross-encoder reranking. The strongest single-shot pipeline in common use; our primary comparison point.

oracle._description: Gold supporting paragraphs only. Upper bound given the fixed reader; separates retrieval error from reading error.

ours._description: Iterative entity-bridged multi-hop retrieval with graph expansion, cross-encoder reranking and coverage-aware multi-document context assembly.
